g.text: Soft. Breathable. Made for Growing Kids.
Comfortable cotton straps designed for everyday wear.
One reusable sensor, multiple sizes, and colors children love.
Pediatric sensors active in both Diaper Clip & Cotton Strap wearing modes
“From curious crawlers to active explorers - comfort for every stage.”
